result.description:
Cooks

Macthom Pty Ltd operates The River Hotel and Margaret River Resort, a well-established hospitality venue at 40 Wallcliffe Rd, Margaret River, Western Australia. The property features a front bar, casual restaurant, courtyard, beer garden and function space.

We are seeking an experienced Cooks to join our kitchen team on a full-time, permanent basis, preparing and cooking food across daily restaurant service at The River Hotel.

Employer: Macthom Pty Ltd
Location: Margaret River, WA 6285
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Annual Remuneration: AUD $79,500 to $84,000 per annum + superannuation

Key Duties and Responsibilities

•	Complete Prep and ensure quality of ingredients prior to preparation
•	Preparing, seasoning and cooking menu items to a consistent standard
•	Portioning, plating and garnishing 
•	Adjusting meals to dietary needs
•	Operate and maintain kitchen equipment and tag report faults
•	Minimize wastage
•	Order, receive and label supplies
•	Support and train kitchen staff

Requirements

•	Able to cook variety of Australian and western dishes
•	At least 1 year of full-time relevant experience or the equivalent of 2 years of part-time relevant experience.
•	Certificate III including at least 2 years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV, or at least 3 years of relevant experience in lieu of a qualification
•	Knowledge of food safety, hygiene and safe food storage practices
•	Knife skills
•	Ability to support and train kitchen staff
•	Ability to work weekends and public holidays

Macthom Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

How to apply:

Applications open on 2 July 2026 and close on 1 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

Waiters
Divyajyoti 2 Pty Ltd

Are you passionate about providing exceptional service and creating memorable dining experiences?  Indian Rasoi Albury (DIVYAJYOTI 2 PTY LTD) is a busy restaurant located in Albury, New South Wales 2640. Indian Rasoi Albury is looking for enthusiastic and dedicated waiters to join our team. Be part of a welcoming and supportive team that values hard work and dedication. Develop your skills and grow within a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

•	Greet and seat guests with a warm and friendly demeanour

•	Serve food and drinks
•	Ensure a clean and organized dining area
•	Assist with setting up and clearing tables

•	Excellent customer service skills
•	A friendly and positive attitude
•	Ability to work efficiently in a team
•	Attention to detail and a passion for hospitality
•	Experience in a similar role is a plus, but not required
•	Ability to work overtime, weekends and public holidays

146 Station Street, Penrith
NSW 2750

Full-Time Cook
Salary $79,499 + Superannuation

About the role
Located on Station St, in the heart of Penrith City, we at Percy Plunkett, we know what our customers want, and we thrive with passion and expertise to make it possible. That is what defines us. https://percyplunkett.com

At Percy Plunkett, we are dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. We offer competitive remuneration, opportunities for career growth, and a range of employee benefits to support your work-life balance.

We are seeking an experienced Cook to join our team at Percy Plunkett, Penrith NSW, 2750. This is a full-time position where you will be responsible for preparing high-quality meals for our customers.


What you'll be doing
•	Prepare and cook a range of meals following the restaurant's recipes and standards.
•	Wash, cut, measure and prepare ingredients before cooking.
•	Cook food using a variety of cooking methods, including grilling, frying, roasting and baking.
•	Check the quality of ingredients and ensure food is fresh and stored correctly.
•	Keep the kitchen, equipment and work areas clean and tidy.
•	Follow food safety, hygiene and workplace health and safety procedures.


What we're looking for
•	Qualifications in commercial cookery and hospitality.
•	At least two years’ experience in a fast-paced kitchen is preferred
•	Strong cooking skills and knowledge of various cooking techniques
•	Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment
•	Excellent attention to detail and commitment to food safety
•	Team player with good communication and problem-solving skill.

Applications open on 27 July 2026 and close on 26 August 2026
